cases.source:
assert ''.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b''
assert 'A\x00\xff\u20ac\U0001f40d\ufeff'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'A+AAAA/yCs2D3cDf7/-'
assert '\ud800'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'+2AA-'
assert '\udc80'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'+3IA-'
assert '\ud800\udc00'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'+2ADcAA-'
assert '\udfffA\ud800'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'+3/8-A+2AA-'
assert '~+\\\t\r\n'.encode('utf_7', 'strict') == b'+AH4AKwBc\t\r\n'
assert b''.decode('utf_7', 'strict') == ''
assert str(b'', 'utf_7', 'strict') == ''
try:
    b'\xff'.decode('utf_7', 'strict')
except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
    assert type(error) is UnicodeDecodeError
    assert error.args == ('utf7', b'\xff', 0, 1, 'unexpected special character')
    assert error.encoding == 'utf7'
    assert error.object == b'\xff'
    assert error.start == 0
    assert error.end == 1
    assert error.reason == 'unexpected special character'
else:
    raise AssertionError("expected codec failure")
try:

assert b''.decode('utf_16_be', 'surrogatepass') == ''
assert str(b'', 'utf_16_be', 'surrogatepass') == ''
try:
    b'\xff'.decode('utf_16_be', 'surrogatepass')
except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
    assert type(error) is UnicodeDecodeError
    assert error.args == ('utf-16-be', b'\xff', 0, 1, 'truncated data')
    assert error.encoding == 'utf-16-be'
    assert error.object == b'\xff'
    assert error.start == 0
    assert error.end == 1
    assert error.reason == 'truncated data'
else:
    raise AssertionError("expected codec failure")

assert ''.encode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == b''
assert 'A\x00\xff\u20ac\U0001f40d\ufeff'.encode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == b'\x00A\x00\x00\x00\xff \xac\xd8=\xdc\r\xfe\xff'

assert '\ud800\udc00'.encode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == b'\x00\\\x00u\x00d\x008\x000\x000\x00\\\x00u\x00d\x00c\x000\x000'
assert '\udfffA\ud800'.encode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == b'\x00\\\x00u\x00d\x00f\x00f\x00f\x00A\x00\\\x00u\x00d\x008\x000\x000'
assert '~+\\\t\r\n'.encode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == b'\x00~\x00+\x00\\\x00\t\x00\r\x00\n'
assert b''.decode('utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == ''
assert str(b'', 'utf_16_be', 'backslashreplace') == ''
